name: Amour
description: Amour is an elegant fruity-floral fragrance created for a soft, romantic and captivating presence. Juicy raspberry and refreshing mint open the scent, followed by a delicate rose heart. Creamy vanilla, warm amber and smooth white musk create a sensual finish that feels graceful, inviting and memorable.

name: Black Code
description: Black Code is a refined aromatic-woody fragrance created for the confident man. Spiced cardamom opens the scent, followed by an elegant blend of lavender, cedarwood and bergamot. Caraway and vetiver form a deep, distinctive base that leaves a sophisticated and memorable impression.

name: Bonded
description: Bonded is a fresh aromatic-woody fragrance created for a confident and effortlessly polished presence. Crisp apple opens the scent, followed by bright bergamot and calming lavender. Smooth sandalwood forms a warm, refined base that leaves a clean, sophisticated and memorable impression.

name: Divine Kiss
description: Divine Kiss is an enchanting fruity-floral fragrance created for a feminine, romantic and captivating presence. Juicy pear, bright bergamot and sweet red berries open the scent, followed by elegant white rose and jasmine. Vanilla, sandalwood, amber and white musk create a warm, sensual and memorable finish.

name: Elite
description: Elite is a sophisticated aromatic-spicy fragrance created for a confident and distinguished presence. Fresh grapefruit and cool mint open the scent, followed by cardamom, lavender and warm cinnamon. Amber and sandalwood form a rich, smooth base that leaves an elegant and memorable impression.

name: Fresh Vibe
description: FreshVibe is an energising citrus-aquatic fragrance created for a clean, vibrant and effortlessly attractive presence. Juicy mandarin and sweet orange open the scent, followed by bergamot, grapefruit and warm ginger. Aquatic notes, smooth musk and earthy patchouli create a fresh, refined and lasting finish.

name: Honey Scent
description: Honey Scent is a warm gourmand-floral fragrance created for a sweet, elegant and captivating presence. Juicy raspberry opens the scent, followed by rich honey and romantic red rose. Creamy vanilla, glowing amber and soft woody notes create a smooth, sensual and memorable finish.

name: Rose Tobacco
top_notes: Cinnamon, Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Saffron, Apple, Pear
base_notes: Tobacco, Madagascar Vanilla, Amber, Woody Notes
description: Rose Tobacco is a rich spicy-woody fragrance created for a bold, sophisticated and captivating presence. Cinnamon, oud, incense and saffron meet crisp apple and pear, followed by patchouli and jasmine. Tobacco, Madagascar vanilla, amber and refined woods create a deep, sensual and memorable finish.

name: Scent Aura
description: Scent Aura is a refined aromatic-woody fragrance created for a bold, elegant and captivating presence. Bright mandarin orange opens the scent, followed by spicy ginger, calming lavender and a soft touch of rose. Leather, woody notes and amber create a warm, sophisticated and memorable finish.

name: Showmix
description: ShowMix is a vibrant fruity-aromatic fragrance created for a confident and modern presence. Juicy melon, pineapple and orange blend with aromatic lavender, followed by spicy pink pepper and fresh geranium. Patchouli, amber and woody notes create a warm, refined and memorable finish.

name: Veloura
description: Veloura is an elegant fruity-floral fragrance created for a feminine, graceful and captivating presence. Juicy pear, sweet raspberry and bright bergamot open the scent, followed by romantic rose and jasmine. Creamy vanilla, warm amber and white musk create a soft, sensual and memorable finish.

name: Velvet Sugar
description: Velvet Sugar is an indulgent fruity-gourmand fragrance created for a feminine, soft and captivating presence. Juicy blackberry and red berries open the scent, followed by rose, orchid and golden honey. Creamy vanilla, warm amber and sandalwood create a smooth, sensual and memorable finish.

name: Spicy Oud
top_notes: Rose, Jasmine, Lily of the Valley
description: The combination of rose, jasmine and lily-of-the-valley adds floral elegance, while saffron, oud, musk and amber provide warmth and intensity. The result is balanced for both men and women, although its deep oud base gives it a slightly masculine character.

name: Dark Aura
base_notes: Tobacco, Vanilla, Black Amber, Leather, Patchouli
description: Dark Aura is a dark woody-spicy fragrance blending warm cinnamon and citrus with praline, black cardamom and incense. Tobacco, vanilla, black amber, leather and patchouli create a rich, addictive and seductive finish made for the night.

name: Lollipop
description: Lollipop is a playful fruity-gourmand fragrance created for a sweet, feminine and captivating presence. Juicy peach, mandarin and neroli open the scent, followed by candy, caramel and luminous white florals. Vanilla, sandalwood, patchouli and white tobacco create a warm, sensual and memorable finish.

name: Fruity Twist
top_notes: Strawberry, Black Currant, Red Apple, Grapes, Citruses
description: Fruity Twist is a vibrant fruity-floral fragrance created for a playful, feminine and uplifting presence. Strawberry, black currant, red apple, grapes and citruses open the scent, followed by sweet pea, freesia, rose and jasmine. Raspberry, white musk, sandalwood and amber create a smooth, memorable finish.

name: Golden Vanilla
description: Golden Vanilla is a luxurious floral-gourmand fragrance created for a warm, elegant and captivating presence. Vanilla orchid and jasmine open the scent, followed by brown sugar, caramel and tonka bean. Vanilla, amberwood, white musk and patchouli create a rich, sensual and memorable finish.
